svg.title: AAPL daily Kalman-Keltner chart study
svg.desc: A candlestick chart of AAPL daily bars overlaid with the Kalman-Keltner study: a fast centerline coloured blue while rising and yellow while falling, a slower drift line in light blue and gold, inner Keltner bands coloured green in bullish drift and red in bearish drift, and neutral outer bands. Markers show bars where the zone score fired. Generated by the production Python engine with illustrative parameters.
svg.text: AAPL · daily · Kalman-Keltner chart study — replicated from the production Python engine
Real daily bars through 2026-08-17 · illustrative parameters, not the tuned production values · 752 bars computed, last 130 shown
